candidate: Read-only support diagnosis and explicit abstention with identity image handoff; no image repair or production shader proposed.
purpose: First resolve real bottle stage/support provenance; preserve current image pipeline. Only then consider any production candidate.

compiler.status: Not applicable to the CPU/read-only candidate. Any later job08-only diagnostic hook must be built and attested locally; existing generated headers are not a new build claim.

priority0_existing_data_export.instruction: Inspect existing2405579e raw capture/manifest first and export only the bounded requested roles. Run the CPU tracer on those exported bytes; do not manufacture an AMD replay from incomplete seven-frame clips.

actual_native_route.required: Real native NRD bridge with actual AMD RR provider; no combined-path substitute, mock provider, standalone analytic shader or stored GPU receipt relabelled as this execution.
actual_native_route.profile_reason: Read actual A_Recon_direct or B_PrePass route from local attestation/native_control_header; not available in compact clip metadata.
record_order: Native owned raw snapshot and geometry preparation
G3 provider-motion substitution with original source D/S
Lobe recovery Record and FlatAlbedo RecordOutput
CompleteBridgeFrame encoded copies before original Consumer
Separate actual final game output capture

window.selection_instruction: Inspect the original capture manifest and preview first. Use frames168..207 only if they contain approach, motion and settle. Otherwise select and report one new consecutive window of at most48 frames; do not splice phases or loop frames.
window.render_extent_policy: These are known dimensions for the existing capture. If a new capture uses another render extent, record its actual per-frame values and revalidate coordinate transforms; do not relabel its pixels as1505x847.
window.crop_policy: Prefer the original fixed128x847 vertical strip, which avoids the seven-frame moving-crop ambiguity. If local preview shows the bottle leaves this strip, choose a single fixed crop with at most108416 pixels; record actual origin/extent rather than clamping or omitting object support.
window.prior_history: Original captured RR output retains the original unseen provider history. The exported first frame has no exported previous image and must be marked unsupported; do not reset or loop to fabricate history.
window.frame_time_status: Read actual per-frame recording QPC/timestamp and its frequency from local capture metadata. The seven-frame fixture does not attest final display times.

G2.parameter_policy: Record actual working values; do not substitute guessed numeric defaults.

G3.parameter_policy: Record actual working values/activity; retain original and provider B separately if captured.

NZR.glass_blend: Preserve actual working choice; record0.5/0.75 or other exact effective value rather than assuming.

input_roles_and_formats.stage: RecordBridgeOwned sources0/1, after current native raw decode and optional Anchor, before optional turn processing and provider radiance scaling; identify actual source routing in metadata.
input_roles_and_formats.units: Restored native linear RGB treated as demodulated by bridge; alpha is native hit-distance payload. Upstream exposure/modulation calibration remains unverified.
input_roles_and_formats.why: Locate bright/lagging or sparse support before RR. Input alpha already exists in the short fixture; the missing observation is longer chronology and its source provenance, not alpha itself.

input_roles_and_formats.stage: Owned provider output after RGB scale restoration, before optional lobe/flat recovery; snapshot.rawDiff/rawSpec.
input_roles_and_formats.units: Restored native linear RGBA; preserve output alpha without interpreting it as the original hit.
input_roles_and_formats.why: Determine whether an additional tail first appears before selected NZR; stored RR output is not converged truth.

input_roles_and_formats.stage: Snapshot.selectedDiff/selectedSpec after lobe recovery and FlatAlbedoRecovery::RecordOutput, before CommitOwned; preserve alias map.
input_roles_and_formats.units: Restored native linear RGBA; actual selected working output, not a reference image.
input_roles_and_formats.why: Localize an added difference to selected recovery while holding source, transport, frame and denominator fixed.

input_roles_and_formats.stage: RecordBridgeOwned providerMotion, including actual G3 substitution if active.
input_roles_and_formats.units: RG full-render UV current-to-previous with camera/raster jitter already included; B signed previous-minus-current linear view-Z or explicit G3 rejection sentinel; A preserved.
input_roles_and_formats.why: Test actual provider transport and separate outside-crop support from real motion. Record B provenance rather than treating every B as geometric truth.

input_roles_and_formats.stage: Optional additional owned copy of input.motion before LightingGuard replaces providerMotion; required if G3 is active and this original is available locally.
input_roles_and_formats.units: Same RG/B convention before G3. Preserve native/camera-only/unknown B provenance when available.
input_roles_and_formats.why: Discriminate a source transport error from a deliberate G3 B rejection. If not captured in original data, mark missing; do not reconstruct it from provider output.

input_roles_and_formats.stage: Owned converted signed linear depth used by the provider.
input_roles_and_formats.units: Signed view-space Z in native scene units; record handedness and near/far bounds.
input_roles_and_formats.why: Lighting-independent geometry witness; no same-surface inference solely from a self-fulfilling previous-visible-depth sample.

input_roles_and_formats.stage: Actual provider guide and original owned guide before FlatAlbedo roughness floor. If they alias, record the alias and transmit one copy.
input_roles_and_formats.units: RG octahedral world-space normal in bits0..19; linear roughness bits20..29; category bits30..31, not a semantic object class.
input_roles_and_formats.why: Check surface transport independent of lobe radiance and distinguish guide preparation from original roughness. Rotation and mixed boundaries remain confounds.

input_roles_and_formats.stage: Actual owned albedo resources passed in the provider descriptor; existing native trace roles.
input_roles_and_formats.units: Linear native material guides Qd/Qs; preserve alpha and provenance. Exact final Consumer remodulation is separately requested.
input_roles_and_formats.why: Required for faithful native provider replay and to avoid attributing a material/domain difference to support history.

input_roles_and_formats.stage: CompleteBridgeFrame after same owned transaction successfully commits, before original Consumer.
input_roles_and_formats.units: Actual RGB or YCoCg according to captured Consumer encoding flag. Title destination alpha is opaque and retained.
input_roles_and_formats.why: Separate bridge encoding from later game composition; do not treat this as final game output.

constants_and_metadata.name: provider_controls
constants_and_metadata.stage: Exact dispatch suffix at byte264 of448-byte descriptor; original bit patterns.

constants_and_metadata.name: frame_parameters_and_settings
constants_and_metadata.format: Original typed JSON plus uint32 IEEE754 words
required: NZR Temporal and Reflection History independently
native decode profile and checkerboard modes if available

constants_and_metadata.name: consumer_modulation_exposure
constants_and_metadata.stage: Original title Consumer/composition operands associated with the encoded commit.
constants_and_metadata.status: No known universally sufficient compact ABI in this package; local extractor must identify actual factors and units, report source offsets/provenance, and mark unknown fields null instead of assuming final energy equals pre-remod lobe sum.
constants_and_metadata.why: Separate H5 from source-domain occupancy; source contract explicitly does not attest material modulation or upstream exposure.

constants_and_metadata.name: independent_geometry_or_feature_witness
constants_and_metadata.format: Small frame-indexed JSON, plus optional immutable bool masks within metadata budget
constants_and_metadata.stage: Independently labelled silhouette/feature tracks from same-pose geometry/final reference, not thresholded candidate radiance.
constants_and_metadata.status: Required to call a source footprint physically wrong rather than merely bright/sparse. If unavailable, retain H1/H3 non-identifiability. Existing speed mask includes hand/arm.

provenance_requirements.source_commit_and_build_identity: Record actual local source commit, clean/dirty status, build configuration, shader artifact/source hashes, AMD provider binary/API/version and native route attestation.
provenance_requirements.capture_identity: Original capture UUID and capture.json SHA256, source-relative filenames, every full source file SHA256, exact crop raw-byte SHA256 and export NPZ/array SHA256.
provenance_requirements.ordering: Original capture, Streamline and SDK frame indices, recording_id, recording_generation, context_generation/domain and reset flags. Preserve actual chronological order.
provenance_requirements.metadata: Copy full original frame_parameters, settings, provider controls, provider_radiance_scales, raw/selected resource alias roles, native_control_header including unknown-word status, source native resource descriptions, crop and copy footprints. No private machine path is needed.
provenance_requirements.formats: Preserve original little-endian words, alpha and signed zero; no colour conversion, half re-store, averaging, tone mapping or clipping in tensor export. Load NPZ with allow_pickle=False.

dimensions_stride_crop.unknown_reason: Read actual resource descriptions and CopyFootprintMetadata from the executed frame. Never infer GPU allocation/rowpitch from the packed cropped export.
dimensions_stride_crop.motion_formula: previous_local = current_local + current_crop_origin + motion_RG * actual_render_extent - previous_crop_origin
dimensions_stride_crop.bilinear_support: Require finite coordinates and complete four-tap support inside previous crop; never clamp or wrap.

baseline_candidate_pairs.baseline: Original no-reset selected D/S and encoded title output in the native working route.
baseline_candidate_pairs.candidate: The same recorded frame passed through CPU support tracing/identity handoff, with optional readback-only native observation; no alternative denoising dispatch or runtime reset.
baseline_candidate_pairs.comparison: Bitwise original versus preserved arrays at each identical observation point, exact frame/role identity and alpha. Use same source run; two independent stochastic game runs are not a bit-equality test.
baseline_candidate_pairs.expected_result: No changed words attributable to diagnostics; separate readback scheduling overhead from image equivalence.

baseline_candidate_pairs.baseline: Raw RR and selected output from one frame and one owned recording.
baseline_candidate_pairs.candidate: Diagnostic switches only displayed observation role, without changing the title commit.
baseline_candidate_pairs.comparison: Per-lobe fixed-support occupancy/tail/level/detail differences, same exposure, all consecutive frames.
baseline_candidate_pairs.expected_result: Localize any extra selected difference; equality only rules out an added selected difference on the stated support.

baseline_candidate_pairs.baseline: No-reset provider context after identical chronological warmup on the actual native input stream.
baseline_candidate_pairs.candidate: Separate diagnostic provider context with the same chronological input/control stream and exactly one provider-only FFX_DENOISER_DISPATCH_RESET at the chosen motion-onset frame; diagnostic output is never committed to the working game.
baseline_candidate_pairs.comparison: Raw RR D/S only at fixed source support and matched exposure; level-normalized shape metrics must accompany raw brightness/detail.
baseline_candidate_pairs.reset_frame_selection: Choose and record the motion-onset source frame after local preview, before evaluating output. Do not automatically assume historical frame183 is correct for a new trajectory.
baseline_candidate_pairs.warmup: For existing complete capture replay, use its original preceding frames locally and keep identical unlooped warmup for both contexts; do not upload warmup tensors. For a new live capture, establish both contexts before the bounded observation window and record actual initialization/history age.
baseline_candidate_pairs.warmup_reason: Original hidden pre-capture history is unavailable; local replay must report its actual shared initial state and cannot claim to recreate it.
baseline_candidate_pairs.required_isolation: Do not reset G3, native geometry, NZR Reflection History, lobe recovery, camera, or frame counters at the same time. If the only available control is RRWrapper::ResetHistory/global frame.reset, it also propagates to downstream histories; label that test coupled_reset_non_identifying instead and retain H4a/H4b uncertainty.
baseline_candidate_pairs.optional_if: Run only if stage localization still requires separating provider history from current source support; no reset is part of the candidate.

startup_reset_order.baseline: No capture-induced reset. Preserve original actual_reset and original frame ids. First exported previous sample is unavailable unless genuinely included.
startup_reset_order.chronology: Approach, motion and settle are one consecutive unlooped sequence. Preserve actual input/control chronology and never stitch independent attempts.
startup_reset_order.diagnostic_state: Invalidate only the tracer observation state on reset, frame gap, convention/extent change or absent crop; do not issue renderer/provider resets.
startup_reset_order.publication: Recorded is not submitted, submitted is not completed, and completion alone does not prove same-domain validity. Publish mapped CPU bytes only under the completed immutable snapshot proof.
startup_reset_order.failure: Cancel/invalidate uncertain captures; retain GPU leases until actual fence completion or proven command-list discard. Missing fields remain explicit null/absent, never zero-filled evidence.

debug_and_lifetime_checks: D3D12 debug layer and GPU-based validation messages captured with actual provider route; require zero new severity/error attributable to the diagnostic hook. Existing unrelated warnings reported separately.
Readback sources retain exact owned resources and generation across command-list execution; snapshots use same recording/context/frame as selected and encoded outputs.
Keep pre-copy and post-copy resource states explicit; preserve UAV/transition ordering around provider restore, recovery and commit.
Borrowed title targets are accessed only inside the existing valid native transaction and not retained as owned resources.
Record physical queue submissions/fence values, completion proof, repeated-execution/cancellation behavior, and rejected domain/settings discontinuities.
Verify source/active/allocation extents, original/full-render motion scale, crop origin and first/outside-crop invalidity.
Preserve all input alpha and selected/title-alpha roles; validate lobe ordering and encoded-mode flag for each late commit.

image_identity.scope: Same source observation before/after CPU diagnostic identity; native readback-only adapter must not write any image role.
image_identity.rationale: No arithmetic image transformation is proposed.

alpha_identity.scope: Compare each preserved role to itself; do not compare input hit alpha with provider or title alpha.

cpu_coordinate_equivalence.scope: Float64 origin-aware math versus packaged CPU reference on identical finite inputs.
cpu_coordinate_equivalence.rationale: Same declared continuous arithmetic; this is not a D3D sampler parity tolerance.

gpu_sampler_parity.status: Not claimed. If a GPU support sampler is later implemented, capture actual sampled history, compile profile/flags and FP16 boundary witnesses before setting a justified tolerance.

tolerances.shape_improvement_reason: No physical silhouette truth or production repair is supplied. A threshold must not be selected from the reset/candidate output.

cpu: Named stage overlays with frozen exposure
Per-frame support/shape/level/temporal metrics with unsupported counts
Explicit diagnostic labels and abstention reasons
native: Existing raw/selected/encoded trace roles only; no replacement image resource from this candidate
output_resources.final_game: Separately synchronized final output under BLOCKED_DATA_REQUEST.json, otherwise unavailable.

timings_memory_scope.instruction: Measure actual same-route baseline/readback-on GPU timestamps, CPU capture time, committed allocation, retained peak and resident VRAM separately. Capture overhead is not zero merely because candidate does not filter. Do not infer full-game budget or AMD internal cost from CPU tests.
timings_memory_scope.paired_scope: Same local capture content/settings and reported observer overhead. Reset-diagnostic extra context costs must not be charged as normal runtime candidate cost.

primary_export_cap.compression: Lossless NPZ/ZIP permitted; cap is on uncompressed useful payload, not a promise about compression ratio.
primary_export_cap.alias_policy: Do not duplicate aliased raw/selected/normal resources; retain explicit alias metadata and hashes.
primary_export_cap.row_pitch_policy: Export rows tightly packed after fence-protected mapping. Record original resource row pitch/stride separately; padding is not requested.
primary_export_cap.original_gpu_row_pitch_reason: Must be taken from each actual CopyFootprintMetadata; not inferred from packed export width.
primary_export_cap.no_extra_payload: Do not upload full full-resolution renders, DLLs, replay caches, opaque provider histories or unrelated captures.

visual_failure_criteria: Any changed rendered word attributable to a purported read-only/identity adapter.
Claiming shorter shape from reduced brightness alone, without level-matched structural comparison.
Mistaking sparse black source samples for proved disocclusion or stale history.
Treating moving crop displacement as object motion or manufacturing history by clamp/loop.
Suppressing one-pixel/sign detail, increasing grain/sparkles/flicker, or changing true-light response in any later image candidate.
Changing working glass/water controls, diffuse lobe or title alpha while diagnosing bottle motion.
Attributing a provider-only cause from a coupled global reset, or calling a reset result clean truth.
Showing only the best frame, using candidate-derived supports, unmatched exposure/aspect or missing timestamps.
Presenting a replay or stored GPU witness as new final game observation.
required_return: Executed local commands and exit codes
Bounded typed stage payloads and metadata hashes
No-reset versus any diagnostic intervention scope and timing
New unlooped motion/same-frame final observations with uncertainty
Local decision: remain research, reject an intervention, or propose a separately reviewed default-off A/B
acceptance_status: CPU diagnostic work can be accepted as research; production visual acceptance remains pending real native GPU/game evidence.
